opening.argument: The video promotes Hashflare cloud-mining contracts through a referral link and shows a paid Equihash Zcash option with a purchase process. The speaker describes confirming payment and says the purchase was successful, then claims the Zcash contract returns more than 200% per year. That combination presents a concrete paid mining offer alongside a striking annual return claim. The screen's profitability forecast displays zero ZEC and USD values, and the evidence does not establish that the claimed returns were achieved or guaranteed. The promotion and purchase process, tied to the more-than-200% annual claim, support the position that this is a paid mining-returns scam.
